ServiceHMAC.name: X-Service-Signature
ServiceHMAC.description: HMAC v2 over exact body/path/query, X-Service-Name, X-Service-Timestamp, X-Service-Nonce and X-Service-Signature-Version. Durable nonce protection. Read caller admin-backoffice-service; publisher is the separately credentialed owner-authorization-context-publisher. Publication additionally requires an independent Ed25519 owner signature over the exact document bytes.

MediaSourceHMAC.name: X-Service-Signature
MediaSourceHMAC.description: HMAC v2; caller media-file-service-case-authorizer. Durable owner/case-proof nonce namespace, separate from admin-backoffice-service reads and owner publication. No alternate caller accepted.
